if level >= gw_start and not gw_done[level] then
        gw_done[level] = true
        gw_solved += 1
    end

if did_change then
        add(history, last_step)
        gw_moves += 1
    end

-- gameworld instrumentation (see game_api.js for the pin map)
gw_solved, gw_moves, gw_start, gw_f, gw_done = 0, 0, 0, 0, {}

function gw_boot()
    local n = peek(0x5f80)
    if n > 0 and n <= 22 and peek(0x5f81) == n + 100 then
        n -= 1
        gw_start = n
        screen = "level"
        level = n
        dset(0, n)
        menu_selected = 1
        load_level()
    end
end

function gw_pub()
    gw_f += 1
    local acts = actors or {}
    local cnt, slots, aligned = {}, 0, 0
    for a in all(acts) do
        local k = a.x..a.y..a.s
        if cnt[k] then
            cnt[k] += 1
        else
            cnt[k] = 1
            slots += 1
        end
    end
    for k, v in pairs(cnt) do
        if (v == 3) aligned += 1
    end
    poke(0x5f88, 83)
    poke(0x5f89, gw_f % 256)
    poke(0x5f8a, screen == "title" and 0 or (screen == "level_select" and 1 or 2))
    poke(0x5f8b, min(level, 255))
    poke(0x5f8c, min(dget(0), 255))
    poke(0x5f8d, min(gw_solved, 255))
    poke(0x5f8e, min(aligned, 255))
    poke(0x5f8f, min(slots, 255))
    poke(0x5f90, min(#history, 255))
    poke2(0x5f91, gw_moves)
    poke(0x5f93, (dialogue > 0 and 1 or 0) + (((entering or 0) + (exiting or 0) > 0 or (glitch > 0 and glitch < 160)) and 2 or 0) + (level > level_count and 4 or 0) + (palette == 2 and 8 or 0) + (dialogue == 1 and 16 or 0))
    poke(0x5f94, lvl_w or 0)
    poke(0x5f95, lvl_h or 0)
    poke(0x5f96, min(#acts, 48))
    for i = 1, min(#acts, 48) do
        local a = acts[i]
        poke(0x5f98 + i * 2 - 2, a.x + a.y * 8 + (a.c - 1) * 64)
        poke(0x5f98 + i * 2 - 1, a.s)
    end
end
